pregunta: Do I need a fishing licence as a foreigner in Corrientes?
texto:
Yes, as a foreigner intending to fish in Corrientes, Argentina, you are required to obtain a fishing license. The province mandates that all anglers, regardless of nationality, possess a valid fishing license to engage in sport fishing activities. ([desarrollovisit.ciudaddecorrientes.gov.ar](https://desarrollovisit.ciudaddecorrientes.gov.ar/quehacer/pesca-deportiva/?utm_source=openai))

**How to Obtain a Fishing License:**

Corrientes has streamlined the process by offering digital licenses, which can be acquired online through the official website of the Dirección de Recursos Naturales (Department of Natural Resources):

- **Website:** [www.recnaturalesctes.gob.ar](https://www.recnaturalesctes.gob.ar/)

This platform allows you to purchase licenses for various durations, including daily and annual options. The system is designed to be user-friendly and is available in multiple languages to accommodate international visitors. ([turismo.corrientes.gob.ar](https://turismo.corrientes.gob.ar/noticia/corrientes-ofrece-un-sistema-de-avanzada-en-la-region-en-la-venta-de-licencias-de-pesca-deportiva?utm_source=openai))

**Important Considerations:**

- **Regulations:** Ensure you familiarize yourself with local fishing regulations, such as catch-and-release policies for certain species like dorado, surubí, and manguruyú, which must be returned to their natural habitat after capture. ([corrientes.com.ar](https://www.corrientes.com.ar/corrientes/pesca-deportiva.php?utm_source=openai))

- **Documentation:** Always carry your fishing license and a valid form of identification (e.g., passport) while fishing, as authorities may request to see them during inspections. ([desarrollovisit.ciudaddecorrientes.gov.ar](https://desarrollovisit.ciudaddecorrientes.gov.ar/quehacer/pesca-deportiva/?utm_source=openai))

By obtaining the appropriate license and adhering to local regulations, you can enjoy a responsible and enjoyable fishing experience in Corrientes.
